events.title: Demo Update 1.0.1: Tutorial Videos, Language Fix and More
events.summary: Hi everyone! Thank you so much for playing the Gildoria demo during Next Fest. Your feedback has been amazing, and this small update fixes the issues many of you reported. FixesTutorial videos now play on all systems. Some videos used a format that Windows could not play without an extra codec, so they showed up blank for many players.The game no longer switches to Arabic the first time you open Settings.Your progress is safe. events.title: The Free Demo is Out Now!
events.summary: The Gildoria demo is here! The dragon's hoard is a mess, and you are the one who has to put it in order. The free demo of Gildoria: Organize a Dragon's Hoard is now live on Steam, just in time for Steam Next Fest. events.title: Gildoria's Art Is Now Fully Human Made!
events.summary: Every piece of art in Gildoria is made by human artists.No ai generated images ship in this game. Not in the interface, not in the icons, not in the key art, not on this store page. What changedEarly in development I used AI-generated placeholders for parts of the interface while the underlying systems were being built. events.title: 10,000+ wishlists in just 10 days
events.summary: The dragon has been asleep for centuries and has no idea any of this is happening. 10.000+ of you have wishlisted his dungeon in just 10 days. I'm one person making this game on my own, and I did not expect that number this early. Thank you all! What you've been telling meThe most common comment on every post, by a wide margin: "where's the dragon?" Fair. He's the entire premise and right now you barely feel him.
